backend/main.mo: Actor implementing access control, user profiles, approval workflow, and chat request management using Maps, Sets, and authorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to affected files, components, tests, and confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing purpose and behavior of numerous frontend files across the React app and Firebase integration.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment runbook detailing build steps, approval gating verification, troubleshooting, and rollback procedures.
frontend/firestore.rules: Firestore security rules defining permissions for users, admins, chat requests, and chat messages with role- and approval-based access checks.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and sets extensive CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Bootstraps the app, loads Firebase via CDN, initializes Firebase services, and mounts the React app.
frontend/LIVE_SMOKE_TEST.md: Comprehensive smoke‑test checklist verifying signup, approval gating, login flows, redirects, and Firestore behavior.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Implements client-side routing using state, renders screens based on path, and applies auth/admin guards.
frontend/src/components/admin/UserRowAct: Provides admin action menu for user rows with dialogs for approve, reject, block, and promote actions.
frontend/src/components/auth/AdminRouteG: Restricts access to admin roles by checking Firestore user profile and redirects on unauthorized.
frontend/src/components/auth/Authenticat: Guards routes requiring authentication by verifying Firebase auth and user profile.
Provides a centered auth page layout with footer branding.
frontend/src/components/auth/SuperAdminR: Allows access only to super_admin users and shows a loading state while verifying.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Renders the main header with logo and profile menu using the current user's profile.
frontend/src/components/layout/ProfileMe: Dropdown menu for profile actions including profile navigation, admin dashboard, and logout.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when updated.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirebaseAuthUser.t: Hook that waits for CDN-loaded Firebase, sets up an auth state listener, and exposes the current user and loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirestorePendingUs: Hook that fetches pending users and provides mutations to approve, reject, block, or promote them with query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirestoreUserProfi: Hook that loads the authenticated user's profile from Firestore once Firebase auth is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirestoreUsersList: Hook that retrieves all users and provides approval and role update mutations with cache refresh.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider for Internet Identity login using AuthClient, exposing identity, login/clear actions, and status flags.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup with light/dark theme variables and base styling overrides.
frontend/src/lib/firebase.ts: CDN-based Firebase wrapper providing auth/db access, dynamic module loading, and helpers for user profile management.
frontend/src/lib/firebaseErrorMessages.t: Maps Firebase error codes to human‑friendly error messages.
frontend/src/lib/firebaseTypes.ts: Shared TypeScript interfaces for user profiles and signup data.
frontend/src/lib/postLoginRedirect.ts: Logic to determine whether users go to /chat or /pending-approval based on profile approval status.
Utility to resize, compress, and validate profile images under 200KB, returning processed file data.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility function that combines class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry that initializes React, wraps providers for React Query and Internet Identity, and mounts the app.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminChatsScr: Admin-protected screen showing a placeholder for future chat management.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminDashboar: Admin dashboard summarizing user statistics with loading states and protected access.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminLayout.t: Shared admin layout providing navigation, sidebar, mobile menu, and wrapping content.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminReportsS: Admin-protected screen with a placeholder for upcoming reports and analytics.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminSettings: Admin-protected settings screen showing a placeholder for future configuration options.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminUsersScr: Admin interface to list, review, and act on pending user approvals with role-based visibility.
frontend/src/screens/ChatScreen.tsx: Implements a real-time chat UI using React Query to load chats and messages, allowing users to select chats and send messages. Includes loading states, empty states, and auto-scrolling behavior.
frontend/src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx: Displays a welcome message and basic onboarding cards for the logged-in user based on their profile. Provides static informational content and a footer.
frontend/src/screens/LoginScreen.tsx: Handles email/password login with Firebase, fetches the user profile, checks account status, and triggers a post-login redirect. Shows validation errors and uses an AuthLayout.
frontend/src/screens/PasswordResetScreen: Provides a UI-only password reset request flow that logs the email and shows a confirmation message. No backend reset logic is triggered.
frontend/src/screens/PendingApprovalScre: Shows a pending-approval notice for users awaiting admin review and explains next steps. Includes informational cards and a button to return to login.
frontend/src/screens/ProfileScreen.tsx: Displays the logged-in user’s profile details with avatar, name, email, and role, including admin indicators. Handles loading and missing-profile states.
frontend/src/screens/SignupScreen.tsx: Signup screen with form fields, profile photo capture/upload, validation, and Firebase signup logic.
frontend/src/screens/users/ApprovedUsers: Displays approved users, fetches and manages chat requests, and allows sending or responding to requests with loading states and UI feedback.
frontend/src/screens/users/UserManagemen: Admin view that lists all users and lets admins update each user's approval status with React Query and Firebase.
frontend/src/screens/UsersScreen.tsx: Loads the current user profile and displays the unified approved users list view.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hash fragments, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, fonts, animations, and plugin setup.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing the admin approval system, role rules, existing features, and architectural constraints.
